gloss: irregular working hours; non-standard work schedule

definitions.gloss: irregular working hours; non-standard work schedule
definitions.explanation: a work schedule that deviates from the standard daytime hours, including shift work, rotating schedules, and split shifts

examples.japanese: {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Irregular working hours put a strain on the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{職業|しょくぎょう}→職業：03245_shokugyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Nursing is a profession with many irregular shifts.

examples.japanese: {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れて→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧、⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Because of irregular working hours, my daily rhythm was disrupted and my sleep quality declined.

notes:
Combines ⟦{変則|へんそく}→変則：25314_hensoku⟧ (irregular, non-standard) and ⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧ (work, duty). Common in healthcare, manufacturing, transportation, and service industries where 24-hour operations require employees to work outside regular business hours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}{手当|てあて}: irregular hours allowance
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: irregular shift system
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to irregular hours
- {変則勤務|へんそくきんむ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|し}いられる→強いる：15604_shiiru⟧: to be forced into irregular hours

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {交代勤務|こうたいきんむ}: shift work — working in rotating shifts with other workers
- ⟦{夜勤|やきん}→夜勤：09549_yakin⟧: night shift — specifically working during nighttime hours
- {不規則勤務|ふきそくきんむ}: irregular work — similar meaning with slightly different nuance
- ⟦フレックスタイム→フレックスタイム：24473_furekkusutaimu⟧: flextime — flexible hours chosen by the worker, a positive arrangement
